audit_boundary.scope: Existing local execution logs, cache metadata, reports and request implementation; no new provider requests.
audit_boundary.reason_unknown: The historical implementation did not persist SDK usage, successful response IDs, request timestamps or cost. Local result counts do not establish provider billing.

canonical_cache.retry_interpretation: 331 saved successful results record one schema/rule correction retry before success. This excludes failed attempts without a successful cache entry and is not a total retry count.
canonical_cache.date_boundary: These are cumulative stored results, not one day's requests. Filesystem modification times were changed by copying and cannot be treated as billing dates.

cache_deduplication.interpretation: Do not add copied cache files as new requests. Conversely, identical cache keys in separate fresh runs do not prove only one request: 85 evaluation keys have different answer data. None of these counts is a provider-confirmed billable request total.

2026-10-30_all_backlog.run_count_boundary: These are overlapping item-processing runs with cache hits, errors and multiple stages per item. Their processed counts must not be summed as distinct papers, HTTP requests or billed calls.

last_summary_batch.warning: The former final 434/434 progress index included cancelled futures. The corrected saved-result count is 58, not 434.

official_posts.boundary: APIStatusError in the first log does not establish HTTP 402 for every item or the provider's billing treatment.

2026-10-30_fresh_gate_evaluation.interpretation: A documented separate live evaluation used an empty cache and produced new answers for overlapping request keys. It added work beyond the main backlog run; its RMB cost was not recorded.

http_402_evidence.boundary: The same exception appears twice in one traceback. Historical reports describe another balance exhaustion, but the local evidence does not establish a total number of HTTP 402 attempts or charges.

usage_search.boundary: Local scan only; no provider billing export was available.

findings: The large dated workload was the full 2026-10-30 backlog, not just the day's HF shortlist.
One item can invoke relevance, classification, Harness gate, evidence, Chinese summary and English translation; excluded or cached items take fewer calls.
The gate used deepseek-v4-pro; other current stages used deepseek-flash. No price or historical RMB amount was inferred from model names.

Multiple stored template versions and schema retries can trigger additional requests. The cache includes rendered prompt, model, paper version and temperature, so changed requests do not reuse the previous key.
The fresh 45-case evaluation is an evidenced repeated-request source; three copied resume caches are not.
Prior reports say paid processing remained paused on 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01. Cumulative cache totals cannot be assigned to yesterday or today.

behavior: Append one record after each real SDK attempt, before schema validation; retries receive separate records.
Cache hits append no request record.
Persist SDK usage as returned; missing usage is null and cost is not guessed.
Exceptions record only type and HTTP status alongside request metadata, not error text, credentials, base URL, prompts or response bodies.
HTTP 402 records one attempt and immediately raises the existing batch-stopping error.
A lock protects concurrent in-process appends. No model, sampling, threshold or output-token setting was changed.

remaining_evidence_needed: A DeepSeek billing/usage export for the charged period, including date/time, model, input/output or cache token categories and charged RMB. Do not substitute local cache counts for that statement.
